events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit, stack ports, and run dir
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -1 a1c8b18a 2>&1; git branch --contains a1c8b18a 2>&1|head -3; git status --short app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs; for p in 8970 8972 8974; do echo "$p: $(lsof -ti:$p -sTCP:LISTEN|head -1)"; done; ls /tmp/t242c/ 2>&1|head -30; ls /tmp/walk/ | grep 242

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check stack process health and logs
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t242c; for f in centre sim funnel runner walk; do p=$(cat $f.pid); echo "$f $p $(ps -p $p -o etime=,command= 2>/dev/null|cut -c1-120)"; done; for p in 8970 8972 8974; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m3 http://127.0.0.1:$p/)"; done; tail -5 walk-webinar.log; ls -la /tmp/walk/242-webinar; tail -5 runner.log; cat admin-url | sed 's/key=.*/key=REDACTED/'

events.text: Webinar walker already reached 75/76 with every job done and no Kie.ai finding; the one remaining finding is the Day 3 live-key swap button. Checking the card's button label now.
